summary: PR-1820 rewrites payments' required_approvals as a single conditional expression. It appears behaviour-preserving, and the ticket, independent approval and CI on the head commit are in order. However, the rewrite is not a comment-only or formatting edit, so under LAP-1 it lapses the exhaustive Rocq proof (ACR-0401) that supports PAY-1, and that proof is not rerunnable. The packet supplies only a grid-based control test, not evidence of the same strength. Nothing is shown to be violated, but PAY-1 cannot be established at the required strength, so the change is held until the proof is re-checked against the head commit.
